arxiv-1911-13090.description: Abstract Stars form in highly-magnetised, supersonic turbulent molecular clouds. Many of the tools and models that we use to carry out star formation studies rely upon the assumption of cloud isotropy. However, structures like high-density filaments in the presence of magnetic fields, and magnetosonic striations introduce anisotropies into the cloud.

arxiv-2303-00816.creator: R. Santorelli, A.I. Barrado Olmedo, E. Conde Vilda, M. Fernandez Diaz, V. Pesudo, L. Romero
arxiv-2303-00816.description: Abstract Measuring the argon purity is critical for all Ar-based rare event research experiments. arxiv-2402-14099.title: EXACT-Net: EHR-guided lung tumor auto-segmentation for non-small cell lung cancer radiotherapy
arxiv-2402-14099.creator: Hamed Hooshangnejad, Xue Feng, Gaofeng Huang, Rui Zhang, Quan Chen, Kai Ding
arxiv-2402-14099.description: Abstract Lung cancer is a devastating disease with the highest mortality rate among cancer types. Over 60% of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients, which accounts for 87% of diagnoses, require radiation therapy. Rapid treatment initiation significantly increases the patient’s survival rate and reduces the mortality rate.

arxiv-2411-14525.title: SegBook: A Simple Baseline and Cookbook for Volumetric Medical Image Segmentation
arxiv-2411-14525.creator: Jin Ye, Ying Chen, Yanjun Li, Haoyu Wang, Zhongying Deng, Ziyan Huang, Yanzhou Su, Chenglong Ma, Yuanfeng Ji, Junjun He
arxiv-2411-14525.description: Abstract Computed Tomography (CT) is one of the most popular modalities for medical imaging. By far, CT images have contributed to the largest publicly available datasets for volumetric medical segmentation tasks, covering full-body anatomical structures. Large amounts of full-body CT images provide the opportunity to pre-train powerful models, e.g., STU-Net pre-trained in a supervised fashion, to segment numerous anatomical structures.

arxiv-2503-00528.title: Efficient Prompting for Continual Adaptation to Missing Modalities
arxiv-2503-00528.creator: Zirun Guo, Shulei Wang, Wang Lin, Weicai Yan, Yangyang Wu, Tao Jin
arxiv-2503-00528.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zirun Guo, Shulei Wang, Wang Lin, Weicai Yan, Yangyang Wu, Tao Jin. Missing modality issues are common in real-world applications, arising from factors such as equipment failures and privacy concerns. When fine-tuning pre-trained models on downstream datasets with missing modalities, performance can degrade significantly. Current methods often aggregate various missing cases to train recovery modules or align multimodal features, resulting in suboptimal performance, high computational costs, and the risk of catastrophic forgetting in continual environments where data arrives sequentially.

arxiv-2505-21422.title: When Shift Happens - Confounding Is to Blame
arxiv-2505-21422.creator: Abbavaram Gowtham Reddy Celia Rubio-Madrigal Rebekka Burkholz Krikamol MuandetCISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security, Saarbrücken, Germany
arxiv-2505-21422.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Abbavaram Gowtham Reddy Celia Rubio-Madrigal Rebekka Burkholz Krikamol MuandetCISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security, Saarbrücken, Germany. Distribution shifts introduce uncertainty that undermines the robustness and generalization capabilities of machine learning models. While conventional wisdom suggests that learning causal-invariant representations enhances robustness to such shifts, recent empirical studies present a counterintuitive finding: (i) empirical risk minimization (ERM) can rival or even outperform state-of-the-art out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization methods, and (ii) its OOD generalization performance improves when all available covariates—not just causal ones—are utilized.

arxiv-2506-02325.title: Ultrahigh-Q Torsional Nanomechanics through Bayesian Optimization
arxiv-2506-02325.creator: A. D. Hyatt, A. R. Agrawal, C. M. Pluchar, C. A. Condos, D. J. Wilson
arxiv-2506-02325.description: Abstract Recently it was discovered that torsion modes of strained nanoribbons exhibit dissipation dilution, giving a route to enhanced torque sensing and quantum optomechanics experiments. As with all strained nanomechanical resonators, an important limitation is bending loss due to mode curvature at the clamps.

arxiv-2508-19284.title: A Comprehensive Review of Denial of Wallet Attacks in Serverless Architectures
arxiv-2508-19284.creator: Mark Dorsett, Scott Mann, Jabed Chowdhury, Abdun Mahmood
arxiv-2508-19284.description: Abstract The Denial of Wallet (DoW) attack poses a unique and growing threat to serverless architectures that rely on Function-as-a-Service (FaaS) models, exploiting the cost structure of pay-as-you-go billing to financially burden application owners. Unlike traditional Denial of Service (DoS) attacks, which aim to exhaust resources and disrupt service availability, DoW attacks focus on escalating costs without impacting service operation.

arxiv-2601-00099.title: Cross-Interaction Softness as a Route to Microphase Separation in Binary Colloidal Systems
arxiv-2601-00099.creator: Umesh Dhumal
arxiv-2601-00099.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Umesh Dhumal. Understanding how interparticle interactions govern phase behavior is central to controlling self-organization in multicomponent soft-matter systems. In particular, the role of cross interactions between unlike components remains insufficiently understood. Here, we systematically investigate how cross-interaction character controls phase behavior in binary mixtures of hard and soft particles using coarse-grained modeling, Reference Interaction Site Model (RISM) theory, and molecular dynamics simulations. Four representative systems are examined that differ only in whether interactions between unlike particles are bounded or hard-sphere.

pmc-11467410.creator: Feiye Zhou, Chunxiang Sheng, Xiaoqin Ma, Tianjiao Li, Xing Ming, Shushu Wang, Jialin Tan, Yulin Yang, Haipeng Sun, Jieli Lu, Jianmin Liu, Ruyuan Deng, Xiao Wang, Libin Zhou
pmc-11467410.description: Elevated circulating branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs) are tightly linked to an increased risk in the development of type 2 diabetes mellitus. pmc-11841432.creator: Shihao Li, Lina Zhang, Haiyang Zhang
pmc-11841432.description: ObjectiveOsteosarcoma is the most common primary bone cancer with a high propensity for local invasion and metastasis. pmc-12436815.description: IntroductionMedical students face high demands in college, which may cause significant psychological stress and mental health problems, such as depression and anxiety. pmc-12512847.title: Obesity induced by a high-fat diet regulates the MYC‒PPIL1 network in the mediation of asthenozoospermia
pmc-12512847.creator: Menghua Shi, Lei Xu, WeiXi Zheng, Xuyao Lin, Guozheng Qin
pmc-12512847.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Male infertility, particularly asthenozoospermia (AZS), has become an increasingly severe global public health issue. Obesity induced by a high-fat diet (HFD) is considered a key factor in the development of AZS, although its exact molecular mechanisms remain unclear. This study employs bioinformatics analysis to explore the key genes and potential regulatory mechanisms of HFD-induced obesity in AZS, which were validated by animal experiments.

uslaw-usc-t42-s2064.title: 42 U.S.C. § 2064 — Disposition of energy; regulation on sale
uslaw-usc-t42-s2064.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s2064.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 23 (Development And Control Of Atomic Energy); Subchapter IV (Production Of Special Nuclear Material). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. If energy is produced at production facilities of the Commission or is produced in experimental utilization facilities of the Commission, such energy may be used by the Commission, or transferred to other.
